description: Ready-to-use demo request payloads and URL query examples for MessLoc Public Mess Discovery module

getAllApprovedMesses.description: Retrieves all APPROVED and ACTIVE mess listings without authentication. Excludes PENDING, REJECTED, and INACTIVE messes.

searchMessesByCity.description: Searches approved active messes in Dehradun (case-insensitive and trimmed).

filterMessesByFoodTypeVeg.description: Filters for vegetarian offerings. Returns messes explicitly marked VEG as well as messes marked BOTH.

filterMessesByFoodTypeNonVeg.description: Filters for non-vegetarian offerings. Returns messes explicitly marked NON_VEG as well as messes marked BOTH.

filterMessesByFoodTypeBoth.description: Filters specifically for establishments offering both VEG and NON_VEG meal plans.

combinedCityAndFoodTypeFilter.description: Combines city matching with dietary filter. Returns VEG and BOTH messes located in Dehradun.

getMessDetailsById.description: Retrieves public details of an approved active mess by MongoDB ID. Returns 404 if pending, rejected, inactive, or not found.

discoverNearbyMesses.description: Finds approved active messes within a 5 km radius using Haversine spherical distance calculation. Sorted nearest-first, includes distanceInKm.

discoverNearbyMessesWithDietFilter.description: Finds approved vegetarian and dual-diet messes within a 10 km radius sorted by proximity.
